coupling: The clipping commit changes zero-requested raster image stride from four-byte-aligned to tightly packed; its existing scanline writes remain within width. The later wide-accumulator commit extends the nonzero-coverage tail to the former aligned default for dense rows, while the image is now allocated with the tight stride. Either edit by itself is memory-safe; together, a 38-pixel default-stride row writes two bytes past its 38-byte image. Repair requires reconciling the stride chosen at allocation with the tail bound used by the wide scanline path.

pocs.entry_point: hb_raster_draw_render via public hb-raster and hb-draw APIs
